name: POP Icon Keys
author: poornan
description: Logitech POP Icon Keys on Omarchy: the Mac-style top row (Show Desktop, Search, Dictation, Emoji, Screen Capture, Lock) mapped to Omarchy actions through Solaar, with keyboard battery in the bar.

barWidget.description: Keyboard battery, the top-row key map, and whether Solaar is routing the keys.

schema.label: Hide the icon when the keyboard is not connected
Show the battery percentage next to the icon
Send keys back to Solaar automatically when the keyboard drops them (after sleep or reconnecting)
